query:
SELECT id, name,
            (CASE
                WHEN is_banned THEN -1
                WHEN finish_at IS NOT NULL THEN 2
                WHEN is_locked THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END)::SMALLINT AS "state!"
        FROM rb_team
        WHERE game_id = $1 AND ($2 = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
        ORDER BY name, id
        LIMIT 50
